rtt_step_pattern.observation: RTTs in this DROP1_OUT run fall on levels about 20 ms apart: {'28 ms': 78, '48 ms': 79, '68 ms': 82, '88 ms': 81, '108 ms': 83, '128 ms': 4, '148 ms': 2, '228 ms': 1, '468 ms': 1, '548 ms': 2, '588 ms': 2} (counts of the 415 selected values by nearest level). The P95 of 107.589 ms is on the 108 ms level. The same pattern is present in the 10 other runs with 415 selected values: concentration R 0.834 to 0.998, share within 3 ms of the ladder 0.870 to 1.000; this run has R 0.998 and share 1.000.
rtt_step_pattern.measure: Circular concentration of RTT modulo 20 ms (R: 0 = even, 1 = all on one phase) and the share of values within 3 ms of the phase centre (a flat spread would give about 0.30).
rtt_step_pattern.status: Observation only. The cause is not established; an earlier working suspicion is system timing granularity. It is kept as a flag so the thesis analysis does not read the steps as network effects.
